$minY = 1;

$dp = [];

for ($y1 = $minY; $y1 <= $maxY; $y1++) {
    for ($y2 = $minY; $y2 <= $maxY; $y2++) {
        if ($y1 == $y2) continue; // no horizontal segment
        $trend = ($y2 > $y1) ? 0 : 1;
        $dp[2][$y1][$y2][0][0][$trend] = 1;
    }
}

for ($pos = 3; $pos <= $n; $pos++) {
    if (!isset($dp[$pos - 1])) continue;
    foreach ($dp[$pos - 1] as $prevY => $byPrevY) {
        foreach ($byPrevY as $currY => $byCurrY) {
            foreach ($byCurrY as $peaks => $byPeaks) {
                foreach ($byPeaks as $valleys => $byValleys) {
                    foreach ($byValleys as $trend => $count) {
                        for ($nextY = $minY; $nextY <= $maxY; $nextY++) {
                            if ($nextY == $currY) continue; // no horizontal
                            $newPeaks = $peaks;
                            $newValleys = $valleys;

                            if ($trend == 0 && $nextY < $currY) {
                                // up then down -> peak at currY
                                $newPeaks++;
                                $newTrend = 1;
                            } elseif ($trend == 1 && $nextY > $currY) {
                                // down then up -> valley at currY
                                $newValleys++;
                                $newTrend = 0;
                            } else {
                                $newTrend = $trend;
                            }

                            if ($newPeaks > $t || $newValleys > $t - 1) continue;

                            if (!isset($dp[$pos][$currY][$nextY][$newPeaks][$newValleys][$newTrend])) {
                                $dp[$pos][$currY][$nextY][$newPeaks][$newValleys][$newTrend] = 0;
                            }
                            $dp[$pos][$currY][$nextY][$newPeaks][$newValleys][$newTrend] += $count;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

}

        foreach ($byPrevY as $currY => $byCurrY) {
            foreach ($byCurrY as $peaks => $byPeaks) {
                foreach ($byPeaks as $valleys => $byValleys) {
                    if ($peaks == $t && $valleys == $t - 1) {
                        foreach ($byValleys as $trend => $count) {
                            $ans += $count;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

<?php
list($n, $t) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$maxY = 4;
$dp = [];

// dp[pos][lastY][peaks][valleys][trend]
// trend: 0 = start, 1 = up, 2 = down
for ($pos = 0; $pos <= $n; $pos++) {
    $dp[$pos] = [];
    for ($y = 1; $y <= $maxY; $y++) {
        $dp[$pos][$y] = [];
        for ($p = 0; $p <= $t; $p++) {
            $dp[$pos][$y][$p] = [];
            for ($v = 0; $v <= $t - 1; $v++) {
                $dp[$pos][$y][$p][$v] = array_fill(0, 3, 0);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Initialize for position 1
for ($y = 1; $y <= $maxY; $y++) {
    $dp[1][$y][0][0][0] = 1;
}

for ($pos = 2; $pos <= $n; $pos++) {
    for ($lastY = 1; $lastY <= $maxY; $lastY++) {
        for ($peaks = 0; $peaks <= $t; $peaks++) {
            for ($valleys = 0; $valleys <= $t - 1; $valleys++) {
                for ($trend = 0; $trend <= 2; $trend++) {
                    $curVal = $dp[$pos - 1][$lastY][$peaks][$valleys][$trend];
                    if ($curVal == 0) continue;

                    for ($newY = 1; $newY <= $maxY; $newY++) {
                        if ($newY == $lastY) continue; // no horizontal segment

                        if ($pos == 2) {
                            // Determine initial trend
                            $newTrend = ($newY > $lastY) ? 1 : 2;
                            $dp[$pos][$newY][$peaks][$valleys][$newTrend] += $curVal;
                        } else {
                            // Need previous y to detect peaks/valleys
                            // We don't store prevY, but we can infer changes using trend:
                            // If trend was up and now newY < lastY -> possible peak at pos-1
                            // If trend was down and now newY > lastY -> possible valley at pos-1
                            $newTrend = $trend;
                            $newPeaks = $peaks;
                            $newValleys = $valleys;

                            if ($trend == 1) { // up
                                if ($newY < $lastY) {
                                    // peak at pos-1
                                    $newPeaks++;
                                    $newTrend = 2;
                                } else { // still up
                                    $newTrend = 1;
                                }
                            } elseif ($trend == 2) { // down
                                if ($newY > $lastY) {
                                    // valley at pos-1
                                    $newValleys++;
                                    $newTrend = 1;
                                } else { // still down
                                    $newTrend = 2;
                                }
                            } else {
                                // trend 0 should not occur for pos>2
                                continue;
                            }

                            if ($newPeaks > $t || $newValleys > $t - 1) continue;

                            $dp[$pos][$newY][$newPeaks][$newValleys][$newTrend] += $curVal;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

$result = 0;
for ($y = 1; $y <= $maxY; $y++) {
    for ($trend = 1; $trend <= 2; $trend++) {
        $result += $dp[$n][$y][$t][$t - 1][$trend];
    }
}

echo $result . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
list($n, $t) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$maxY = 4;
$count = 0;

// y[1..n], 1-based
$y = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);

function dfs($pos, $n, $t, $maxY, &$y, $peaks, $valleys, $lastDir, $lastDiff, &$count) {
    if ($pos > $n) {
        if ($peaks == $t && $valleys == $t - 1) {
            $count++;
        }
        return;
    }

    for ($val = 1; $val <= $maxY; $val++) {
        if ($pos > 1 && $val == $y[$pos - 1]) continue; // no horizontal segment

        $prevDir = $lastDir;
        $prevDiff = $lastDiff;
        $newPeaks = $peaks;
        $newValleys = $valleys;

        if ($pos > 1) {
            $diff = $val - $y[$pos - 1];
            $dir = ($diff > 0) ? 1 : -1;

            if ($pos > 2 && $prevDir != 0 && $dir != $prevDir) {
                // direction change at pos-1
                if ($prevDir == 1 && $dir == -1) {
                    $newPeaks++;
                    if ($newPeaks > $t) continue;
                } elseif ($prevDir == -1 && $dir == 1) {
                    $newValleys++;
                    if ($newValleys > $t - 1) continue;
                }
            }

            $lastDirNew = $dir;
            $lastDiffNew = $diff;
        } else {
            $lastDirNew = 0;
            $lastDiffNew = 0;
        }

        $y[$pos] = $val;

        // pruning: remaining positions can't create enough peaks/valleys
        $remaining = $n - $pos;
        // each new peak or valley needs at least 2 more points (one for change in, one for change out),
        // but for a loose upper bound we can say remaining >= needed
        if ($newPeaks > $t || $newValleys > $t - 1) continue;

        dfs($pos + 1, $n, $t, $maxY, $y, $newPeaks, $newValleys, $lastDirNew, $lastDiffNew, $count);
    }
}

// start DFS
dfs(1, $n, $t, $maxY, $y, 0, 0, 0, 0, $count);

echo $count . PHP_EOL;
?>

list($n, $t) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$maxY = 4;
$dp = [];

// dp[pos][y][dir][peaks][valleys]
// dir: 0 = down, 1 = up
for ($y = 1; $y <= $maxY; $y++) {
    $dp[1][$y][0][0][0] = 0;
    $dp[1][$y][1][0][0] = 0;
}
for ($y = 1; $y <= $maxY; $y++) {
    $dp[1][$y][0][0][0] = 0;
    $dp[1][$y][1][0][0] = 0;
}
for ($y = 1; $y <= $maxY; $y++) {
    // initial direction is undefined; we will handle it by allowing both dirs from pos 2
    $dp[1][$y][0][0][0] = 1;
    $dp[1][$y][1][0][0] = 1;
}

for ($pos = 2; $pos <= $n; $pos++) {
    for ($yPrev = 1; $yPrev <= $maxY; $yPrev++) {
        for ($dir = 0; $dir <= 1; $dir++) {
            for ($p = 0; $p <= $t; $p++) {
                for ($v = 0; $v <= $t - 1; $v++) {
                    if (empty($dp[$pos - 1][$yPrev][$dir][$p][$v])) continue;
                    $curVal = $dp[$pos - 1][$yPrev][$dir][$p][$v];
                    if ($curVal == 0) continue;

                    for ($yCur = 1; $yCur <= $maxY; $yCur++) {
                        if ($yCur == $yPrev) continue; // no horizontal segment

                        $newDir = ($yCur > $yPrev) ? 1 : 0;
                        $newP = $p;
                        $newV = $v;

                        if ($pos >= 3) {
                            // need y_{pos-2} to detect peak/valley; we encode via direction change
                            // previous direction stored in $dir, newDir is current
                            if ($dir != $newDir) {
                                if ($dir == 1 && $newDir == 0) {
                                    // up then down -> peak
                                    $newP++;
                                } elseif ($dir == 0 && $newDir == 1) {
                                    // down then up -> valley
                                    $newV++;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if ($newP > $t || $newV > $t - 1) continue;

                        if (!isset($dp[$pos][$yCur][$newDir][$newP][$newV])) {
                            $dp[$pos][$yCur][$newDir][$newP][$newV] = 0;
                        }
                        $dp[$pos][$yCur][$newDir][$newP][$newV] += $curVal;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

$result = 0;

    for ($dir = 0; $dir <= 1; $dir++) {
        if (!empty($dp[$n][$y][$dir][$t][$t - 1])) {
            $result += $dp[$n][$y][$dir][$t][$t - 1];
        }
    }
